T0561.title: Click Injection
T0561.definition: A mobile attribution fraud technique that inserts fake clicks shortly before conversion to steal credit.
T0561.description: Click injection inserts fake clicks shortly before a real install or conversion to steal attribution credit. It is common in mobile advertising and can abuse app permissions, background monitoring, or SDK behavior. Controls focus on click-to-install time distributions, device behavior, channel baselines, and anomalous SDK detection.
T0561.usageExample: Assess Click Injection related exposure and define the corresponding controls.
